QUOTE: "This is a two-phase "ask for size, then fill" pattern." and "So for tokenize I would not call it retry logic. Nothing is retried after an error: the second call is the real call."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer concludes tokenize's double call is size negotiation (null buffer probe, then fill), explicitly not retry-on-failure, with the second call made unconditionally. It doesn't use the words backoff or attempt counter, but the substance is stated.
